newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble dips on long-covering, lower reserve demands.
newsitem.headline: Rouble dips on long-covering, lower reserve demands.

text.p: The rouble eased on long-covering and lower rouble reserve requirements from May 1, dealers said on Tuesday and added it firmed briefly in early trading on bank client demand ahead of Wednesday's sales of government bonds.
On May 14 the Finance Ministry will offer 7.50 trillion roubles of 182-day GKO discount Treasury bills and four trillion roubles in an additional 714-day tranche of OFZ interest-bearing bonds.
roubles/dollar May 13 midday May 13 early May 12 close
"The dollar could firm today as banks needed funds for covering their short forward positions," TOKObank dealer Pavel Shirshov said.

Rossiisky Natsionalno-Kommerchesky Bank dealer Alexander Kuznetsov said roubles could be flowing in after the central bank had lowered by two percent its requirements for banks' rouble reserves as of May 1.

"Banks transfer their reserves the first days of each month, while the central bank pays back during the second week. Banks received roubles on their accounts after requirements were changed this month," he said.
